title_sq: Cmim Okazion! Tek Ish-Profarma, Shitet Apartament 1+1, Me Planimetri Dhe Orientim Perfekt !
description_sq: Cmim Okazion! Tek Ish-Profarma, Shitet Apartament 1+1, Me Planimetri Dhe Orientim Perfekt !! Apartamenti ka nje siperfaqe totale prej 62.6 m2 dhe neto 53.2 m2 . Ndodhet ne katin e 7 dhe eshte i organizuar me korridorin qe ben shperndarjen ne sallon dhe kuzhine me dalje ne ballkon, dhoma e gjumit dhe tualeti. Mund te pershtatet edhe ne 2+1 te vogel. Bashke me apartamentin shitet edhe nje post parkimi me kosto ekstra ne vlere 20 mije euro. Apartamenti lokalizohet ne nje zone te kualifikuar dhe te re ne aspektin e infrastruktures, si dhe nje projekt bashkekohor me hapesira rekreative. Ndertimi sapo ka filluar dhe pritet te perfundoje brenda afatit 2 vjecar.
title_en: Bargain price! In the former Profarma, 1+1 apartment for sale, with perfect layout and orientation!
description_en: Bargain price! At the former Profarma, 1+1 apartment for sale, with perfect layout and orientation!! The apartment has a total area of ​​62.6 m2 and net 53.2 m2. It is located on the 7th floor and is organized with a corridor that divides the living room and kitchen with access to the balcony, bedroom and toilet. It can also be adapted to a small 2+1. Along with the apartment, there is also a parking lot for sale at an extra cost of 20 thousand euros. The apartment is located in a qualified and new area in terms of infrastructure, as well as a contemporary project with recreational spaces. The construction has just started and is expected to be completed within 2 years.
